$comment: BETA-FINAL PR8 / spec B3 - allowlisted packaged payload contract. scripts/release/inspect-package.mjs refuses any shipped file not matched here; deny always wins over allow. Globs: '*' inside a path segment, '**' across segments, '/' separators. Extend asar.allow the same day a runtime dependency is un-excluded from electron-builder.yml's '!node_modules/**/*' blanket (see that file's PR8 note).

signing.$comment: BETA-FINAL PR9 / spec B4 - expected-signature contract consumed by scripts/release/verify-signatures.ps1. expectedSignedFiles: .exe files that MUST carry the beta certificate's Authenticode signature (same glob rules as allow lists; wildcard entries match zero or more). thirdPartySignedFiles: upstream-signed .exe electron-builder does not re-sign (resources/elevate.exe ships inside Electron's dist, outside the signing walk - see app-builder-lib winPackager.signApp); they must be Valid if signed at all. Any *.exe not matched by either list is rejected as unexpected. installerSigned: the NSIS -Setup.exe artifact must carry the beta signature too.
